query_params.query:
Determine whether the homepage text represents a company whose core business intent is:

Mandatory (must be clearly present):
- Being a construction, civil/heavy construction, engineering, or related project-delivery firm that provides contracting, design-build, engineering, MEP, specialty trade, or consulting services.
- The business appears to pursue project-based work through bids, proposals, tenders, RFPs, or similar competitive procurement processes, or clearly operates in markets where such pursuits are a central part of winning work.

Reject if:
- The company is not a construction, engineering, contractor, design-build, specialty trade, MEP, or related project-delivery firm.
- The business is primarily a software vendor, product manufacturer, equipment supplier, retailer, marketplace, staffing firm, agency, or other company serving the construction industry rather than delivering construction or engineering projects itself.
- The homepage indicates a completely unrelated industry or business purpose.
- There is definitively no indication that the company pursues project-based client work, bids, proposals, tenders, or similar contract opportunities.

Nice-to-have confidence signals (non-mandatory, may increase confidence only):
- General contractor positioning
- Design-build services
- Civil or heavy construction projects
- MEP contracting
- Specialty trade contracting
- Engineering or consulting engineering services
- References to pre-construction, estimating, proposal development, bid management, pursuits, tenders, or RFP responses
- Evidence of being an established operating business with a portfolio of completed projects
- Focus on commercial, infrastructure, industrial, institutional, or public-sector projects

Decision rules:
Yes - If the mandatory intent is clearly central to the business
Partial - If the company is adjacent, related, or plausibly involved in construction or engineering project delivery, but bidding/proposal activity is not clearly established from the homepage
No - If the mandatory intent is definitively absent or the business has no plausible connection to construction or engineering project delivery

Output only one of:
Yes
Partial
No
